text: Transportation Services is recommending that vehicles greater than two metres in width be prohibited from travelling the lane west of Sorauren Avenue, south of Fermanagh Avenue

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited vehicles over 2.0 metres in width from travelling in the first lane, west of Sorauren Avenue, south of Fermanagh Avenue between Fermanagh Avenue and the lane west of Sorauren Avenue, north of Wright Avenue.
